why.title: "I know what to do. I just don't do it."
paragraphs: Maybe you spent years putting everyone else first, and now you're not sure what you want anymore. Maybe you've retired, or the house has gone quiet. Or you're juggling work and family and starting over every Monday.

None of that means you've missed your chance. Usually it means you've been last on your own list for a long time. The group is open to anyone ready to change that, and it's closest to Sheila's heart for women at every stage of life.

options.title: What the three months look like

items.label: Group coaching
items.title: Total Transformation Coaching
items.text: You look at how your mindset, choices, habits, stress, relationships and goals connect, then change one thing at a time in your everyday life instead of everything at once.

image.alt: Four women sit together in a bright living room, talking in a small circle

story.title: A few years before 62, Sheila was struggling with her own health.
paragraphs: She knows what it feels like to know you need to change and to wonder if you can really do it. What helped was deciding to put herself back on her own priority list. At 62 she became a certified personal trainer.
"Transformation isn't simply about changing your body," she says. "It begins with changing the way you think, the choices you make, and the way you show up for yourself."
Today she is also a transformation specialist and sugar detox coach, and she co-owns a Hotworx fitness studio with her daughter. Her greatest qualification, she says, is her own transformation.
